mapper.sql: p.id AS id, p.app_id AS appId, a.name AS appName, a.repo_branch AS repoBranch, p.name AS name, p.status AS status, p.version AS version, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM dev_pipeline_stage s WHERE s.pipeline_id = p.id AND s.version = p.version AND s.is_deleted = 0) AS stageCount, p.create_time AS createTime, p.update_time AS updateTime
FROM dev_pipeline p LEFT JOIN dev_app a ON a.id = p.app_id AND a.is_deleted = 0
